```{python}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

import io
import requests
import pandas as pd
import plotly.graph_objects as go
import plotly.io as pio
from datetime import datetime, timedelta

pio.renderers.default = "plotly_mimetype+notebook_connected"

end_date   = datetime.today()
start_date = end_date - timedelta(days=365)

HEADERS = {"User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0"}

def fetch_boe_series(code: str, col_name: str) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Fetch a single series from the BoE Statistics CSV API."""
    url = (
        "https://www.bankofengland.co.uk/boeapps/database/_iadb-FromShowColumns.asp"
        "?csv.x=yes"
        f"&Datefrom={start_date.strftime('%d/%b/%Y')}"
        f"&Dateto={end_date.strftime('%d/%b/%Y')}"
        f"&SeriesCodes={code}"
        "&CSVF=TN"
        "&UsingCodes=Y"
    )
    resp = requests.get(url, headers=HEADERS, timeout=20)
    resp.raise_for_status()
    df = pd.read_csv(io.StringIO(resp.text))
    df.columns = ["Date", col_name]
    df["Date"]     = pd.to_datetime(df["Date"], format="mixed", dayfirst=True)
    df[col_name]   = pd.to_numeric(df[col_name], errors="coerce")
    df = df.dropna().sort_values("Date").reset_index(drop=True)
    return df

df_base  = fetch_boe_series("IUDBEDR", "Base Rate")
df_sonia = fetch_boe_series("IUDSOIA", "SONIA Rate")
```

## About This Dashboard

This dashboard tracks two key sterling interest rates published daily by the
[Bank of England](https://www.bankofengland.co.uk/statistics):

| Series | Code | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| **Base Rate** | IUDBEDR | Official Bank Rate set by the Monetary Policy Committee |
| **SONIA** | IUDSOIA | Sterling Overnight Index Average — the unsecured overnight lending rate |

Data covers the **last 12 months** and is retrieved directly from the
[BoE Statistics API](https://www.bankofengland.co.uk/boeapps/database/).

---

## Chart 1 · Bank of England Official Base Rate

```{python}
#| label: fig-base-rate
#| fig-cap: "Bank of England Official Bank Rate (daily) — last 12 months"

latest_base = df_base["Base Rate"].iloc[-1]
latest_base_date = df_base["Date"].iloc[-1].strftime("%d %b %Y")

fig_base = go.Figure()

fig_base.add_trace(go.Scatter(
    x=df_base["Date"],
    y=df_base["Base Rate"],
    mode="lines",
    line=dict(color="#C8102E", width=3, shape="hv"),   # step-chart for discrete MPC changes
    fill="tozeroy",
    fillcolor="rgba(200,16,46,0.08)",
    name="Base Rate",
    hovertemplate="<b>%{x|%d %b %Y}</b><br>Base Rate: <b>%{y:.2f}%</b><extra></extra>"
))

# Annotate the latest value
fig_base.add_annotation(
    x=df_base["Date"].iloc[-1],
    y=latest_base,
    text=f"<b>Current: {latest_base:.2f}%</b><br><sub>{latest_base_date}</sub>",
    showarrow=True,
    arrowhead=2,
    arrowcolor="#C8102E",
    bgcolor="white",
    bordercolor="#C8102E",
    borderwidth=1,
    font=dict(size=11, color="#C8102E"),
    xanchor="right",
    ax=-60,
    ay=-40
)

fig_base.update_layout(
    title=dict(
        text="<b>Bank of England Official Bank Rate</b>"
             "<br><sup>Daily policy rate — last 12 months</sup>",
        font=dict(size=18, family="Arial, sans-serif"),
        x=0.5,
        xanchor="center"
    ),
    xaxis=dict(
        title="Date",
        showgrid=True,
        gridcolor="#F0F0F0",
        linecolor="#D3D3D3",
        tickformat="%b %Y"
    ),
    yaxis=dict(
        title="Interest Rate (%)",
        showgrid=True,
        gridcolor="#F0F0F0",
        linecolor="#D3D3D3",
        ticksuffix="%",
        zeroline=True,
        zerolinecolor="#D3D3D3"
    ),
    plot_bgcolor="white",
    paper_bgcolor="white",
    hovermode="x unified",
    margin=dict(t=90, b=70, l=70, r=40),
    legend=dict(orientation="h", y=-0.15),
    annotations=[
        dict(
            text=(
                'Source: <a href="https://www.bankofengland.co.uk/monetary-policy/the-bank-rate">'
                'Bank of England Statistics (IUDBEDR)</a>'
            ),
            showarrow=False, xref="paper", yref="paper",
            x=1, y=-0.18, xanchor="right",
            font=dict(size=10, color="grey")
        ),
        # "current value" annotation already added above via add_annotation
    ]
)

fig_base.show()
```

> **Note:** The Base Rate moves in discrete steps decided by the Monetary Policy
> Committee (MPC), which typically meets eight times a year. The step-chart
> shape reflects those discrete changes.

## Chart 2 · SONIA Overnight Rate

```{python}
#| label: fig-sonia
#| fig-cap: "SONIA (Sterling Overnight Index Average) — last 12 months"

latest_sonia = df_sonia["SONIA Rate"].iloc[-1]
latest_sonia_date = df_sonia["Date"].iloc[-1].strftime("%d %b %Y")

fig_sonia = go.Figure()

fig_sonia.add_trace(go.Scatter(
    x=df_sonia["Date"],
    y=df_sonia["SONIA Rate"],
    mode="lines",
    line=dict(color="#003087", width=2),   # BoE navy blue
    fill="tozeroy",
    fillcolor="rgba(0,48,135,0.07)",
    name="SONIA",
    hovertemplate="<b>%{x|%d %b %Y}</b><br>SONIA: <b>%{y:.4f}%</b><extra></extra>"
))

# Annotate the latest value
fig_sonia.add_annotation(
    x=df_sonia["Date"].iloc[-1],
    y=latest_sonia,
    text=f"<b>Latest: {latest_sonia:.4f}%</b><br><sub>{latest_sonia_date}</sub>",
    showarrow=True,
    arrowhead=2,
    arrowcolor="#003087",
    bgcolor="white",
    bordercolor="#003087",
    borderwidth=1,
    font=dict(size=11, color="#003087"),
    xanchor="right",
    ax=-60,
    ay=-40
)

fig_sonia.update_layout(
    title=dict(
        text="<b>SONIA — Sterling Overnight Index Average</b>"
             "<br><sup>Daily unsecured overnight lending rate — last 12 months</sup>",
        font=dict(size=18, family="Arial, sans-serif"),
        x=0.5,
        xanchor="center"
    ),
    xaxis=dict(
        title="Date",
        showgrid=True,
        gridcolor="#F0F0F0",
        linecolor="#D3D3D3",
        tickformat="%b %Y"
    ),
    yaxis=dict(
        title="Rate (%)",
        showgrid=True,
        gridcolor="#F0F0F0",
        linecolor="#D3D3D3",
        ticksuffix="%",
        zeroline=True,
        zerolinecolor="#D3D3D3"
    ),
    plot_bgcolor="white",
    paper_bgcolor="white",
    hovermode="x unified",
    margin=dict(t=90, b=70, l=70, r=40),
    legend=dict(orientation="h", y=-0.15),
    annotations=[dict(
        text=(
            'Source: <a href="https://www.bankofengland.co.uk/markets/sonia-benchmark">'
            'Bank of England Statistics (IUDSOIA)</a>'
        ),
        showarrow=False, xref="paper", yref="paper",
        x=1, y=-0.18, xanchor="right",
        font=dict(size=10, color="grey")
    )]
)

fig_sonia.show()
```

> **Note:** SONIA is a volume-weighted overnight rate administered by the Bank
> of England. It tracks very closely to the Base Rate but reflects actual
> market transactions, so it fluctuates daily within a narrow band.

## Summary Table

```{python}
#| label: tbl-summary
#| tbl-cap: "Latest values for both rate series"

summary = pd.DataFrame({
    "Series":  ["BoE Base Rate", "SONIA"],
    "Code":    ["IUDBEDR",       "IUDSOIA"],
    "Latest Value (%)": [
        f"{df_base['Base Rate'].iloc[-1]:.4f}",
        f"{df_sonia['SONIA Rate'].iloc[-1]:.4f}",
    ],
    "As of": [
        df_base["Date"].iloc[-1].strftime("%d %b %Y"),
        df_sonia["Date"].iloc[-1].strftime("%d %b %Y"),
    ],
    "# Obs (12 months)": [len(df_base), len(df_sonia)]
})

summary.style \
    .set_properties(**{"text-align": "center"}) \
    .set_table_styles([
        {"selector": "th", "props": [("text-align", "center"), ("background-color", "#003087"), ("color", "white")]},
        {"selector": "td", "props": [("padding", "8px 12px")]}
    ]) \
    .hide(axis="index")
```
